zh: 还缺 %s 木材；准备好了再点「好呀」。
en: Still need %s wood. You can say yes when it is ready.

zh: 材料够了，点头后她才会开工。
en: Supplies are ready. She starts only after you say yes.

zh: 这张提议已失效，请关闭后重新查看。
en: This idea has changed. Close this card and check again.

zh: 木材还不够，这张提议会等着你。
en: There is not enough wood yet. This idea can wait.

zh: 她正忙着或很饿，等她方便时再确认。
en: She is busy or very hungry. Try when she is ready.

zh: 这块位置被占用了，请稍后或换一个提议。
en: That spot is occupied. Try later or ask for another idea.
